profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend | Crafting Customer Success Experiences @ Hubspot
profile.summary:
Software engineer focusing on building great user experiences. I've worked at both mid-stage startups and larger companies.

Currently developing tools at HubSpot to help our users better connect with their customers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Customer Success
Senior Software Engineer - Service Hub Mobile Team
Senior Software Engineer - Service Hub Admin Team
positions.description: Skills: React Native · Front-End Development · React.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Front-End Development · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributing UI knowledge to guide web app build process for internal platform rebuild 
Coding a microservices architecture using Java & Node.js to build back end components for new research platform 
Working alongside cross-functional Agile team using Scrum & TDD methodologies

positions.title: Product Development Analyst
positions.description:
Creating interactive data visualizations to improve data visibility using d3.js
Building & rebuilding data ingestion/cleanup processes to improve product quality and speed using SQL 
Developing new customization features for dynamic user experience using JavaScript/jQuery/HTML 
Managing and resolving product bugs by working with client-facing teams to ensure user satisfaction  
Interfacing with internal tools to maintain and update product features

positions.title: Digital Data Editor
positions.description:
Streamlined data import processes by programming 5+ Python scripts that automated process components
Reduced eBook description loading time by overhauling processes using Python
Cleaned and imported metadata files (XML, HTML, Excel) to ensure data quality by using internal tools
Worked with publishers to promote eBooks by setting promotional pricing

positions.title: Assistant to the CFO
positions.description:
Analyzed accounting reports for yearly audit
Created Pivot Table reports using MS Excel for budget analyses
Posted daily account activity to billing software

positions.title: Operational Support Assistant
positions.description:
Improved invoice batching procedure time by over 50% within 1st week using MS Excel
Created Excel templates to reduce time spent on routine tasks
Entered invoice information into central database to ensure timely payment

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Led weekly 75 minute lectures on introductory psychology material for a group of thirty students
Advised students on issues related to course content and material

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Reduced 20+ hour data entry process to an MS Excel macro that executed in under 5 minutes 
Developed interactive computer programs using HTML/CSS/JavaScript for use during experiments 
Interviewed and taught self-control techniques to participants in an intervention style study

positions.title: Deposit Operations Intern (Seasonal)
positions.description:
Resolved transaction discrepancies by communicating with branch employees
Researched and reconciled issues with customer accounts
Coordinated external mailings
Trained and oriented new hires on mailing procedures

honors.title: Dean's Undergraduate Research Fund Recipient
